name: Affective Evaluation Benchmark (AEB)
description: AEB is a comprehensive affective evaluation benchmark designed to test the generalization ability of large language models on affective analysis tasks, including 8 regression and 6 classification tasks from various sources and domains.
reputation: AEB is a recent benchmark for affective analysis generalization and has emerging use in evaluating LLMs across multiple sentiment and emotion tasks.
notes: Includes a large multi-task affective analysis instruction dataset (AAID) with 234K samples; supports both classification and regression affective tasks.
